ns2:section.sectionText: Music Composition Workshop Fusing the Elements, 2 hours. An active composition workshop for student composers of varying skills and backgrounds. The course will introduce students to a wide sampling of compositional techniques and approaches, and also to a large number of traditional and culturally diverse instruments. There will be an emphasis on Experimental and Cross-Cultural music, as broadly defined over the past 50-100 years. Improvisation and jazz/rock/pop elements will be integrated into the fabric of the course. Students will have the opportunity to invent instruments for which they can compose, and a portion of the course will include composition using computers. Music composed by participating students will be presented and discussed in class. The ability to read and write music at at least an introductory level is strongly preferred. First Year Discovery Program Course. Registration restricted to freshmen. Students should enroll in only one Discovery course.
